Synchronized mouse, motion and focus listener for the game canvas.
RasterBuffer subclass implementing ImageProducer that hands its pixels to an ImageConsumer.
IntrusiveNode subclass with an independent secondary link pair and key, with its own unlink.
Iterator that walks a DualLinkDeque through its secondary links.
Abstract subclass of GameAppletShell holding shared client and connection state.
Iterator over the bucket chains of an IterableNodeHashTable.
Iterable circular deque of DualLinkNode with sentinel, add and iterator.
KeyListener and FocusListener with synchronized key press, release and focus-lost handlers.

namingTool.adaptation: Resolve named member/local class binary prefixes from javac declaration simple names, preserving local ordinals and dollar characters. Compose containing-class renames recursively, including untouched top-level dollar names. Constructors, owner/type descriptors, literal loading, lexical labels and all bindings are recompiled and verified; output collisions fail before publication.
